premise: One record per gene, joined across every artefact on disk. The absences are values: a gene measured in the screen and found in no cancer subgroup is a different statement from a gene that was never measured, and each layer publishes the scope it could have spoken about.
worldPremise: What the public catalogues already hold about each gene, read per gene rather than in aggregate. The ClinVar VUS share is included as a measurement of attention, not of the gene: a gene whose variants nobody could interpret is a gene nobody had the cohort or the assay for.
geoCaution: Variant density tracks sequencing depth and curation attention as well as biology. A cluster is evidence of a hotspot OR of a well-studied region, and nothing here can separate the two.
domCaution: UniProt features are curated. A protein with no annotated domain is usually a protein nobody has characterised, not one without structure — the same attention bias the VUS share measures, one layer down.

domKinds.membrane: a membrane-spanning segment; mostly out of reach from the cytosol
domKinds.motif: a short functional sequence — a localisation signal, a cleavage site
domKinds.binding: holds a ligand, metal or nucleotide — where small molecules act

relRoutes.graph: shares at least one catalogued disease, from the disease-gene graph
relRoutes.family: shares a UniProt domain family — the same fold doing the same job
relRoutes.lineage: selected in the same DepMap cancer subgroup — an experiment said so
relRoutes.disease: named by the same catalogued disease

dsConvention: Where only one number was measured, min and max are empty rather than filled with the typical. A datasheet that repeats the typical in all three columns is lying about what was measured.

organismal.claim: Under strong selection in people; needed by almost no cell line.
organismal.reading: Its importance is organismal — development, immunity, a tissue no dish contains. A pipeline that ranks on the cell assay discards it every time, and the assay is not silent about it, it is the wrong instrument.
organismal.rule: LOEUF < 0.35 and dependent in < 2% of lines

cultureArtefact.claim: Needed by nearly every line; broken freely in human populations.
cultureArtefact.reading: One of the two is wrong. Either the culture is the artefact — a dependency of growing in plastic — or the constraint estimate is. Worth checking before either number is quoted.
cultureArtefact.rule: LOEUF > 1.0 and dependent in > 90% of lines

selective.claim: Needed hard by a minority of lines.
selective.reading: The shape a selective target has: a strong effect where it exists, absent in most of the panel. This is what the whole screen exists to find, and it is a shape rather than a rank.
selective.rule: dependent in 2%–50% of lines and a minimum effect below -1.0

unreadable.claim: Clearly matters; its variants cannot be classified.
unreadable.reading: Not an interesting mystery. A gene the field has already decided matters and has not funded the assay for — the intersection is a priority list nobody publishes.
unreadable.rule: LOEUF < 0.35 and VUS share > 70% over at least 20 variants

broadButSelective.claim: Expressed across the body; needed by a minority of lines.
broadButSelective.reading: Being on everywhere does not make a gene a poison — what a therapy has to survive is the dependency, not the transcript.
broadButSelective.rule: expressed above zero in every measured cell type and dependent in 2%–50% of lines

damageInDomains.claim: Pathogenic variants concentrate in annotated parts; uncertain ones do not.
damageInDomains.reading: Weak evidence that the uncertain variants outside those parts are tolerated — the most useful thing a positional map can say to a curator, and it is weak on purpose: an annotated region is also a well-studied one.
damageInDomains.rule: pathogenic enrichment inside domains/binding/active > 1.25x, and more than 1.4x the uncertain enrichment, over >= 10 of each

insCaution: Every input carries attention bias: constraint is measured where people sequenced, dependency where somebody cultured a line, variants where a clinic sent a sample, domains where a curator wrote an annotation. An intersection of two biased measurements is not less biased — it is differently biased, and no rule here can tell a real disagreement from two sampling frames. These are prompts to look, never conclusions.
